spans.text: Elevation is a change in height on the game board. When there is an Elevation change, it is
denoted with a dashed purple line and Elevation box. The following rules apply:
A figure who is at a higher Elevation than a target they are Attacking Gains
Attack rolls made against that target.
Line of Sight can only be drawn between two figures on different Elevations so long as
Line of Sight is drawn through spaces with lower Elevation than the highest of the two
Elevations occupied. Meaning, the figure occupying the space on the higher Elevation
must be on the edge of that Elevation. When drawing Line of Sight between two figures
that occupy different Elevations, ignore all other figures who occupy Elevations that are
lower than the highest Elevation occupied by either figure.

If Remi ended her turn here, the Current could not move her since she is blocked by the
Animate. Instead, she would bounce off the Animate and be dealt
the space she was unable to move. Additionally, since Remi did not move, she would not
provoke a Break Attack from the Animate.
